question: Which of the following schemes enables students mobility across Higher Education Institutions?

options.text: Structured Assessment for Analysing Learning Levels (SAFAL)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Academic Bank of Credits**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) scheme allows** students to move between higher education institutions by enabling the accumulation, recognition, transfer, and redemption of credits: 
 
• A **digital platform that stores a student's credits earned throughout their learning journey **
 
• Students can open accounts and use the ABC to enter and leave colleges or universities 
 
• Students can seamlessly integrate their skills and experiences into a credit-based system 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Educational Technology Forum (NETF):**

 
 
• The National Educational Technology Forum (NETF) **is an initiative aimed at promoting the use of technology in education.**
 
• It is **expected to provide a platform for discussions, advice, and recommendations regarding educational technology policies and innovations.**
 
• NETF** aims **to foster the integration of technology in teaching and learning to improve education quality in India.
 
 
 
• **PM Umeed Scheme**:
 
 
• The PM Umeed Scheme is a** government initiative aimed at empowering rural women, particularly in the areas of self-help groups (SHGs).**
 
• Under this scheme, **women are provided financial support, training, and access to resources to start small businesses and improve their economic conditions.**
 
• It f**ocuse**s on encouraging entrepreneurship and providing socio-economic benefits to women in rural areas.
 
 
 
• **Structured Assessment for Analysing Learning Levels (SAFAL)**:
 
 
• SAFAL is a **national-level initiative launched by the government to assess the learning outcomes of students in schools.**
 
• The program **aims to** provide a structured assessment to analyze and understand the learning levels of students, identify areas for improvement, and help enhance the overall quality of education.
 
• The **SAFAL initiative is designed to help teachers and education policymakers** by providing actionable data on student learning progress.
